purpose: Approved official BIS sources for the SIH26107 prototype. This registry is not itself the RAG knowledge base.

records.title: Product Certification Overview
records.planned_use: High-level certification, compulsory-certification, and product-information guidance.
records.notes: Treat statements about compulsory certification as time-sensitive and cite the page in every answer.

records.title: Product Certification Process
records.planned_use: Process-level guidance for Scheme I and related public documents.
records.notes: The assistant must link users to the current BIS process page instead of treating this record as legal advice.

records.title: Product Certification Frequently Asked Questions
records.planned_use: Frequently asked certification questions, online application guidance, and laboratory guidance.
records.notes: Fees, deadlines, and portal workflows can change; answers must state the source-check date.

records.title: Product Specific Guidelines
records.planned_use: Find public product manuals, inspection and testing schemes, and grouping guidelines for selected demo products.
records.notes: Each linked manual needs its own registry record and reuse review before any download or ingestion.

records.title: Know Your Standards: Indian Standard Search
records.planned_use: Look up an Indian Standard title, number, revision information, and related public metadata when users describe a product.
records.notes: Do not store or reproduce standard text. Results must identify the retrieved standard number and direct users to BIS.

records.title: Laboratory Services Overview
records.planned_use: Laboratory-services guidance and links to test facilities and laboratory lists.
records.notes: Laboratory availability and recognition status are dynamic; use LIMS for current results.

records.title: Laboratory Services Frequently Asked Questions
records.planned_use: Explain how users can find BIS, recognized, and empanelled laboratories.
records.notes: The assistant must not claim that a lab is currently eligible without a current LIMS check.

records.title: BIS Laboratory Information Management System
records.planned_use: Direct users to a current laboratory or Indian-Standard-wise search.
records.notes: Do not cache lab status as a permanent fact; the portal itself is the authority for live information.

records.title: Hallmarking Frequently Asked Questions
records.planned_use: Consumer-facing hallmarking basics and verified links to related BIS information.
records.notes: Use precise source citations because hallmarking requirements and terminology may be revised.

records.title: Scheme-X Certification Frequently Asked Questions
records.planned_use: Clearly scoped Scheme-X questions for eligible product categories.
records.notes: Only answer Scheme-X questions when the retrieved source explicitly supports that scheme and product context.
